# ADR-3226: AWS logging: CloudTrail log file validation setting for trail 2

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Without validation, log tampering is harder to detect.

## Decision

Trails MUST enable a CloudTrail log file validation setting for trail 2 (AWS-logging-2).

## Consequences

Validation digests are monitored.
